# neo4j-backup

> Policy-driven Neo4j Enterprise backup and restore: agentless `neo4j-admin` backup to object
> storage, seed-from-URI restore with alias-swap or by-name cutover, PITR, verify, and retention —
> over a shared core with Dagster, Airflow, and CLI front-ends.

An agent operates this through the MCP server (MCP.md: a prompt per operator workflow) or the
`neo4j-backup` CLI. Every command emits one JSON
object under `--json` and a documented exit code; mutating commands require `--confirm` and support
`--dry-run`.

## Agent guide

- [MCP.md](MCP.md): connect an agent to the MCP server; a prompt per operator workflow, and its tools.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to drive the CLI safely — safety posture, command surface, worked examples.
- [CLI-CONTRACT.md](CLI-CONTRACT.md): the JSON envelope, exit-code table, and dry-run/confirm guard rules.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what the project is and where to start.
- [OPERATOR.md](OPERATOR.md): the six operator workflows, each on its own page under workflows/ with agent, CLI, Dagster and Airflow paths.
- [workflows/restore.md](workflows/restore.md): the restore runbook (restore points, preview, restore, undo).
- [RECOVERY.md](RECOVERY.md): the recovery modes with the exact Cypher, for restoring by hand.
- [POLICY.md](POLICY.md): writing the backup policy; [POLICY-FIELDS.md](POLICY-FIELDS.md) lists every field.
- [ENVIRONMENT.md](ENVIRONMENT.md): every environment variable and its default.
